A '''battle''' occurred on [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], toward the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] infiltrated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and burned several [[Grub-hatchery|grub-hatcheries]].

The mission was conducted by the [[Fourth Outer Rim Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], who invaded the world using several [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]].

Although the [[Neimoidian Home Defense Legion/Legends|Neimoidian Home Defense Legion]] was present on the planet at that time and were equipped with [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] they were no match for the battle hardened troops of the Republic army.
